conditions.measurement_temperature_correction: Already transposed by authors to dry air at 25 degrees Celsius; do not correct twice.

supporting_sources.purpose: Physical constants and impedance convention; inspected as text, not executed.

limitations: Production solver currently has no thermoviscous wall losses, finite-flange radiation or closed-end selection.

Agreement on pipe impedance does not validate driver coupling or horn far-field output.
